role: @MainActor service that runs the morning overnight pipeline (raw backup, same-night merge, artifacts, sleep-boundary poll, window selection, HRV analysis, vitals, insufficient-data gate, recovery score, same-night supersede) and returns a ProcessingResult for RRCollector to apply; it does not mutate UI state itself.
types: MorningProcessingService: class (@MainActor final) — morning pipeline; extended by +Merging, +Sleep, +Analysis
MorningProcessingService.ProcessingResult: struct — session, verification, recovery window, baseline deviation, same-night link ids
MorningProcessingService.SettingsSnapshot: struct — settings values copied by the caller (schedule, scoring/ANS config, merge mode/gap)
MorningProcessingService.AnalysisPhaseResult: struct — flags, verification, sleep poll, window, analysis result
MorningProcessingService.OvernightRequest: struct — every input of one morning pass
state: mem:MorningProcessingService.skipSleepWait (var Bool; reset false at processOvernightData start, set true by the BackgroundTaskAssertion expiry handler (MorningProcessingService.swift:195) and by the user's skip-wait button (RecordView+Sections.swift:234); read by pollHealthKitSleep)
mem:MorningProcessingService.now (NowProvider) / sleep (SleepProvider) injected clock and sleeper
toplevel: Type aliases StatusCallback (@MainActor (RRCollector.MorningProcessingStatus)->Void), NowProvider, SleepProvider. SettingsSnapshot defaults sessionMergeMode .defaultGap, mergeGapSeconds nil. No globals.

flags.text: Injected windowSelector, artifactDetector and verification are stored but never read: detectArtifacts/selectWindow build fresh ArtifactDetector()/Verification()/WindowSelector() defaults, so any non-default instance injected (tests or RRCollector.makeMorningProcessingService) has no effect. SettingsSnapshot.enableTrainingLoadIntegration and OvernightRequest.cachedTrainingLoad (doc: 'for recovery score calculation') are likewise unused (computeRecoveryScore takes it as `cachedTrainingLoad _`).

units.does: Stores the eight injected dependencies plus the clock (default Date.init) and sleeper (default: Task.sleep(nanoseconds:) with cancellation swallowed).

branches.cond: Task.sleep throws (only on task cancellation) inside the default sleep closure
branches.effect: error swallowed; the closure returns early so a cancelled poll loop continues to its next check without waiting; no throw otherwise

units.does: Steps 5-7: runs off-actor artifact detection + verification, the sleep-boundary poll (timedSleepPoll), off-actor window selection ranked against the prior-nights baseline, then timed HRV analysis; returns all five results as AnalysisPhaseResult.
Returns BaselineTracker.recoveryBaselineStats excluding the session's own night under the snapshot's sleep schedule.

Public entry: opens a BackgroundTaskAssertion named 'MorningProcessing' whose expiry handler sets skipSleepWait=true, resets skipSleepWait=false, runs run(request) and ends the assertion on return (defer).

flags.text: skipSleepWait is one shared flag on the service: processOvernightData resets it to false at entry, so a skip tapped (RecordView+Sections.swift:234) before the pass starts is discarded, and a concurrent pass (the nonisolated past-night repair calling processOvernightData at RRCollector+BackupRecovery.swift:744) resets or inherits the other pass's skip/expiry state.

units.does: Memberwise initializer for OvernightRequest; defaults streamingBeats 0, deviceBeats nil, isBackgroundRefinement false, prefetchedSleepData nil, statusCallback nil.
Steps 1-7: awaits the off-thread raw RR backup, builds the merged same-night series, calls the no-op gap log, builds the analyzing session, runs the analysis phase, and assembles the result.
Unpacks request/merge result and forwards to runAnalysisPhase with totalBeats = request.points.count (unmerged count).
Builds the .analyzing HRVSession (same id, merged effective start, merged series) whose endDate is the base session's end, else the merged series' last-beat wall time, else now().

branches.effect: endDate = baseSession.endDate when set; else Self.seriesEnd(of: merged) (start + last beat endMs); else now() when the series is empty

units.does: Wall-clock time of the merged series' last beat: effectiveStartDate + last.endMs/1000; nil when the series is empty.

Steps 8-12: builds the final session, finishes it (vitals, insufficient gate, score, supersede) and returns ProcessingResult with verification, recovery window, BaselineTracker.deviation and the merge's same-night links.

flags.text: ProcessingResult.baselineDeviation comes from BaselineTracker.deviation(for:), which compares against currentBaseline (all nights in the tracker, including later nights on a past-night repair) while window ranking, the insufficient gate and the score use recoveryBaselineStats(excludingNightOf:) (prior nights only), so the deviation shown and the score are measured against different baselines.

units.does: Attaches the vitals snapshot (foreground only), applies the insufficient-data gate, computes the recovery score and writes recoveryScore/scoreBreakdown/frozenReadiness, then (complete foreground sessions only) adds same-night supersede links.

branches.effect: foreground: fetch vitals and attach; background: vitalsSnapshot stays nil, which also means scoring gets nil vitals when a sleep snapshot exists
sets recoveryScore (0-10), scoreBreakdown, frozenReadiness (ReanalysisService.computeFrozenReadiness with the passed trainingContext); nil → score fields left unset
supersedes same-night sessions under the user's merge settings; otherwise (failed session or background) no supersede

flags.text: Background-refinement passes (used by the past-night repair in RRCollector+BackupRecovery.swift:744-751) skip attachVitalsSnapshot, and scoringHealthData then returns session.vitalsSnapshot (nil) whenever the poll produced a sleepSnapshot, so the repaired night is scored with no vitals; computeRecoveryScore also leaves referenceDate at its Date() default, so a repaired past night's baseline-staleness penalty is measured against today rather than that night (rescore paths pass sessionEnd).

units.does: Calls supersedeSameNightSession with the snapshot's sleep schedule, merge mode and merge gap.
Fetches HealthKit recovery vitals relative to session end (or now()) and stores them as vitalsSnapshot with RHR replaced by the analysis-window mean HR when an analysis exists.
reads: hk:recovery vitals (RHR, HRV SDNN, respiratory rate, SpO2, wrist temperature as fetched by fetchRecoveryVitals)

branches.effect: reference date falls back to now()

units.does: If an analysis result exists, computes baseline RMSSD = exp(lnRmssdMean) of the prior-nights baseline (0 when none) and marks hrvDataQuality = .insufficient when ReanalysisService.hasInsufficientData says so (RMSSD below baseline and window too short or no organized recovery on a short session).

branches.effect: baselineRmssd = 0, so hasInsufficientData's `rmssd < baselineRmssd` is false and the session is never marked insufficient without a baseline
return; true → hrvDataQuality = .insufficient and a PHI-free log line

flags.text: The gate's comment says it runs before scoring 'so the score computation uses the baseline-HRV fallback', but computeRecoveryScore never passes useBaselineHRV (default false), so the morning score of a night marked .insufficient uses its own low HRV. That score is what the results screen shows before acceptance, what archiveForReview pre-archives (RRCollector+MorningProcessing.swift:56), what paused sessions are archived with (RRCollector+PauseResume.swift:59-68) and what the past-night repair archives (RRCollector+BackupRecovery.swift:744-753); acceptance re-scores with baseline HRV (SessionAcceptanceService.swift:245-248), so the number changes on Accept. The comment's 'Reanalysis applies the identical check' also does not hold for acceptance, which uses classifyHRVQuality (window-less result counts session length as the window, plus .preSleep), so the morning mark and the accepted mark can differ.
